content.application_contract: Apply only to the independently declared existing exposed soil face explicitly selected for source target selected_surface. Require that same carrier to be present and declared as a soil_face. Preserve its existing soil material identity. Select thin horizontal soil peds stacked within this one face, their bounding separation planes and the continuous soil matrix around them. Do not add soil, excavate a new face, replace soil with an artifact or claim classification, origin or performance.
